The **Normalization** group of the node palette has 5 nodes: all run.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [BatchNorm](../normalization/batchnorm.md) | Runs | Normalize activations with batch statistics and running estimates. |
| [GroupNorm](../normalization/groupnorm.md) | Runs | Normalize channels in groups for each sample. |
| [InstanceNorm](../normalization/instancenorm.md) | Runs | Normalize each channel independently per sample. |
| [LayerNorm](../normalization/layernorm.md) | Runs | Normalize the trailing feature dimensions of each sample. |
| [Squeeze-Excitation](../normalization/squeeze-excitation.md) | Runs | Scale each channel of a feature map by a learned gate. |
